::: {.why}
A linear regression on daily, weekly and monthly realised variance outperforms most of the GARCH family out of sample, which is worth knowing before you spend a week on maximum likelihood.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the HAR specification and the economic story behind its three horizons.
- Report the out-of-sample comparison between HAR, GARCH and EWMA under a loss function you chose in advance.
